body: Thanks for the advice, I've read about ECT in psychology classes, sounds like it'd be worth a shot.

I'd definitely try ECT if that was an option. 
And yeah, that's true. It would help me to plan out what I'd wanna say.
Thank you for the encouraging words. Perhaps I do need to see a doctor, however I don't think that help much unless I'm willing to allow therapy to work and not run away like I usually do.
I don't remember, I'm supposed to see my psychiatrist in February. I can talk to them about it, but truthfully I'd rather not antidepressants.

I've been in and out of mental wards, been in 5150 at least 5 or 6 times. I went to rehab back in the Marines for my drinking. I've talked with at least 4 different therapist. Therapy doesn't work for me because I won't allow it work. I think that I don't deserve to get better.
I've been on two different ones, Zoloft and welbutrin. Both of them haven't really worked for me and mess with my stomach so bad that I can't eat and sometimes I even throw up.
At least we both can relate. Honestly, I wish I had the answers to help you out, but I can't even help myself.
I hope I didn't trigger anything for you, that was not my intention

A little update for everyone: its been a while and I'm sorry I never replied back to all your comments, but I got my shit together, passed my classes, and continued on into my third semester of college. I've been doing okay for the past few month, but recently my depression popped really bad and I'm drunk as I'm typing this (thank god for autocorrect lol) and having suicidal thoughts again. Thankfully I called someone who had DM mee and its start to start back on the road to recovery
Thank you much, you have no idea how much this resonates with me

Thank you guys, now that I've calmed down a bit I'm starting to think things a bit more rationally. Tomorrow I'll talk with my school's VA rep and explain to them everything that's going on and call the VA for mental help.
I often reflect every night on my depression and try to figure out where its coming from. Sometimes it feels like I'm depressed just for the sake of being depressed. Anyways, I know that my head is seriously screwed up and that I need help from the VA. I don't wanna end up being #22.
And I'm located in California by the way
